rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged C:cph_out_of_range (their crop boxes cut off the lower part of the text line)
notes: Born-digital monotonic thesis on medical robotics/imaging (the catalogue title 'Μαθήματα φυσικής' 1957 is wrong) with an English reference list. All labels match the text, including the references and the genuinely repeated citation lines 21-23 (the thesis repeats the same reference as nos. 65-67). But the crops of lines 24, 25, 28, 29 and 36 cover only the upper half of the text line, so the image is cut through the letters while the label is the full line. All five carry C:cph_out_of_range, while the clean short lines with only C:aspect_out (6, 11) are fine.
